notes.title: V3.9.3 Online Ranking Improvements
notes.content:
Online highscores, rankings and statistics increased and fixes:

V3.9.3
[list]
[*] When leaving online games early, the chip difference is transferred, but no score is awarded. Rank points are calculated based solely on the score, not on the chips.
[*] Bugfix: Not all hands and statistics were being saved.
[/list]

V3.9.1
[list]
[*] Highscores show 100 entries now
[*] Online ranking and statistics up to 2000 entries
[*] [b]Lags in transmitting rankings and statistics[/b] in the online game have been fixed. Server speed now massively increased.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31252967/fa9104fb1b11ca6d7172bd16f43f1f5e2e62d1cd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Card Game Skat 3D Premium released!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070770/Skat_3D_Premium]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31252967/67aa9681339a810d57796fb30452381f9bacfb1c.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1]Our new card game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070770/Skat_3D_Premium]Skat[/url] is now available[/h1]
Just like Trendpoker it can be played against AI opponents or Online

[h1]About the game[/h1]
Skat is a [b]trick-taking card game[/b] with 3 players very similar to Spades, and [b]national game of Germany[/b]. All popular rule variants and very powerful but adjustable AI opponents are waiting for all who want to play this traditional card game. Game rules can be learned in the animated [b]Tutorial[/b].

Every single round, first the one who plays against 2 others has to be determined. This is done by the auction (German: "Reizen") meaning betting and competing, player with strongest bet may define the Trump suit - but plays against 2 other players!

notes.title: Update: New Environments, Cards, Music and Features
notes.content:

notes.title: More Card Games.. and Modding
notes.content:
15 Single-Player Card Games will be released next weeks:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/941920/Classic_Card_Games_3D/

For both products and in general we welcome and support graphic mods of open files, so feel free to create and include own card backs or environments!

notes.title: New Features and Games
notes.content:
we'll release an Extended Update and other Card Games within next months and 2019!

So far we mainly made improvements behind-the-scenes - technical stuff dedicated to the players.

Trendpoker is all: Tutorial and Introduction into Poker, Single Player and Full Multiplayer Support and Online Community!

We will not do in-game-sales or play-for-money, but we will improve the game! and ask for your feedback and ideas: 

1) Possibility to show folded cards such as other suggested improvements in discussions
2) What annoys you the most when you play the game?
3) Avatars or other new online stuff?

Feel free to leave comments and ideas!

notes.title: Version 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31252967/062fc5d35205ae8c866ac15821a854a8b0d93fcd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dear friends of Poker,[/h1][b]thank you for so many great ideas and positive feedback![/b] Price is now permanently lowered to 14.99 USD. While working on a free demo and new features for a major update, at first we've [b]fixed all known bugs[/b] and made [b]various improvements[/b] primarily to ensure quality and compatibility.

[h1]Version 2.0 notes:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Screen resolution support[/b] for non-standard aspect ratios: up to 2.5 width-height ratio supported now (+fixes for problems with 5:4 and windowed mode resolutions)
[*][b]Delete buttons[/b] for savegames added
[*][b]Touchscreen control support[/b]:
game can be played with windows tablet pcs now
[*][b]Heads-up-tournament steam achievements[/b] are working now
[*][b]Singleplayer highscore bugfixes:[/b]
entries show correct players count and are not overwritten
[*][b]Graphics & user interface changes:[/b]
layout, graphic improvements and fixes such as GUI elements background change from white to black, softshadow quality improved, layout corrections and other
[*][b]Other fixes:[/b]
in some previous versions chatting didn't work, in specific cases, game crashed or didn't run without any error message
[/list]

notes.title: Release 12.12.
notes.content:
Due to quality issues the release date has finally been moved to 12.12.!

The game is about serious poker learning and playing against A.I. and online. It's for training and improving skills - or just playing (with your friends or family) - no real money and you don't have to pay for the chips or any other than the game. But game statistics give you the feedback, if you're bankrupt or potentially successful.

We focus on the exclusive release on Steam 12.12.

BufoProject Team
